**¶3:** The

ial, spiritual, and natural. For

**¶4:** The
 third combat is that of the Divine

 and natural mind. It drew

ion of evil —

**¶5:** This
 is the nature

ansed and purified every
 truth

**¶6:** The
 fourth combat is that
 which
 the
 Lord as
 Divine
 Wisdom glorified w

ious falsities that had risen in

 exterior degrees
 of the mind. When wisdom

 form

 of

int were loosened and

 The
 Glor
ified Divine

 fourth combat, came and brought this

ion of evil to

. He girded himself with power
 and confront
ed the
 whole
 of

 second
 time. He re
-established the entire
 order of heaven and arranged
 all
 things into

 final
 tem
ptation,
 and

ame in

. He fulfilled the purpose
 of the Divine
 itself
.
 He

 of

 most
 ancient celest
ial perception and

 to the understanding
 illumin
ated by wisdom —
 the
 vessel
 that

 light
 of truth on
ward.

**¶7:**
 The fifth combat is that which
 Divine
 Providence itself
 wages
 —
 which
 is the calling
 forth
 of
 truth
 and its
 reception
 in the will. It is
 the greatest
 of

 and
 it placed
 its
 domin
ion upon every
 state
,

coming spiritual

.
 And
 it was
 victorious over spiritual
 death forever
, and it best
owed the heav
enly kingdom —
 the eternal
 reign of good con
joined with truth.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The sons of light waged five wars against the sons of darkness. The sons of light humiliated the sons of darkness in them all.

The first war is that of the First living Man, which he waged against the King of the realms of Darkness, and all the rulers that had come forth from the five worlds of [darkness]. He hunted them with his net, which is the living soul. He [trapped them] in the snare and [revealed] the face of the [light,] his virgin, the living fire[, and] they did not find how to escape his net[. And] he caught them like fish [by means of] the five counsels of the five elements [of light]. He cut and dug out the root of the five trees, [the very] root of the evil tree, like an axe.

The fourth war is this that Jesus the glorious one waged against all the rebels who had rebelled above and below. When the light was purified from them by the image of the Third Ambassador, their chains loosened [and they rose up in open rebellion]. The glorious one in the fourth war; he came and brought [to an end] a rebellion of the entire ruling-power. He girded himself [with power and confronted] all of it another time. He constructed the whole structure and he made [of it] a great contest; he humiliated therein. [And] he fulfilled the will of the greatness, [he gave the] hope to Adam [and guided him] to his light ship.
[Thus] the good are victorious over the wicked [and shall reign] for ever and ever.

This is what
 the ruling-power is like [in
 its greed], all riches [
it seizes] as they travel [
toward the] light [above]. He
 cleansed and purified it.

The second war is that of the Living Spirit [...]. He has constructed the things and the worlds of light; he spread out the rulers and chained them in the middle [...] the stars in [...] the earths [...] them in the three vessels. For the rulers rebelled and were set against the Living Spirit. They wished to [...] since they knew and realised that he might bind and fetter them with a strong chain. Yet he, the Living Spirit, (appeared to them) with many aspects, with numerous [...], with many hands and great cruelties. He was revealed to them, he imprisoned them with much skill. Not one of them was able to save (himself), and he [...] [...]. Now, since he [...] he trapped them [...] [...].
